FIELDS.NAME: Stitch & Style Atelier
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stitch & Style Atelier specializes in custom garment creation and alterations for individual clients, focusing on personalized service. Our operations include bespoke tailoring for formalwear, with a strong emphasis on quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. We offer a range of services from clothing repairs to complete outfit design, and cater to specific needs such as wedding attire and costume design, ensuring a high-value yet manageable inventory. Our appointment-only fitting system helps to control customer flow, reducing liability risks while providing a tailored experience. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail, using skilled labor and advanced techniques to create unique and stylish garments that meet the diverse needs of our clientele.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
1) Water damage due to a leaking roof, January 10, 2022, caused by heavy rainfall, $2,500, Closed.  
2) Theft of sewing equipment, June 5, 2023, break-in during business hours, $1,200, Open.  
3) Fire incident from a faulty electrical outlet, August 15, 2021, caused $5,000 in damage, Closed.  
4) Minor injury to a customer caused by a loose thread on a fitting room floor, February 20, 2023, $500 medical expenses, Open.  
5) Cost of fabric inventory damaged during heavy flooding in the store, March 8, 2020, $3,000, Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday - Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Wall-mounted safe, Class B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with monitoring and onsite security personnel during business hours.
